questions.stem: Balu had thrice as many paper clips as David. The number of paper clips Balu had was twice the number of paper clips Riyan had. If Riyan had 267 paper clips, how many more paper clips than David did Balu have?
questions.solution:
(A) Riyan → 267 paper clips

Balu → 2 × 267

= 534 paper clips

David → 534 ÷ 3

= 178 paper clips

534 – 178 = 356

Balu had 356 more paper clips than David

questions.stem: Tillu had 34 fewer marbles than Jai. Karan had twice as many marbles as Jai. If jai had 1344 marbles, how many marbles did the three boys have altogether ?
questions.solution:
Number of marbles with jai = 1344

Number of marbles with Tillu

= 1344 – 34 = 1310

Number of marbles with Karan

= 1344 × 2 = 2688

Total number of marbles with the three boys = 1344 + 1310 + 2688 = 5342

Tarun’s mother has a mass of 42 kg. She is 3 times as heavy as Tarun. His father is 57 kg heavier than Tarun. Find the total mass of the three of them.
questions.solution:
Tarun’s mother → 42 kg

Tarun’s mass → 42 ÷ 3 = 14 kg

Tarun’s father = 57 kg + 14 kg = 71 kg 42 + 14 + 71 = 127 kg

Total mass is 127 kg

questions.stem: Four schoolmates Akash, Bunny, Chotu and Dhoni were born in the same year. Their birthdays were on January 15<sup>th</sup>, June 13<sup>th</sup>, March 28<sup>th</sup> and Janauary 28<sup>th</sup> not necessarily in this order. Bunny and Akash were born in the same month. Akash and Chotu were born in the same day of different month. Who is the youngest ?
questions.solution:
Bunny and Akash were born in the same month → January month

Akash and Chotu were born in the same day of different month → 28<sup>th</sup> day

Therefore Akash was born January 28<sup>th</sup>

Bunny was born January 15<sup>th</sup>

Chotu was born March 28<sup>th</sup> and

Dhoni was born June 13<sup>th</sup>

Dhoni is the youngest one.
